name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 8 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-05-11, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
